issues.issue: Unexplained line on the form, so 'other' is defensible, but for an agricultural society it is most likely fair/event revenue (charges for services/fees); it is 90% of the year's receipts, so the governmental 'other' share exceeds 10%

An unexplained line that is 90% of the year's receipts should have a decision_needed entry (what is it: fair/event receipts, donations, loan proceeds?); the extraction has none (the Sheridan County Historical Society extraction added one for the same situation)
